seo.title: Delta Air Lines: AI dynamic pricing with Fetcherr - 3% of domestic fares, target 20% (2025)
seo.meta_description: Delta sets about 3% of its domestic fares via Fetcherr's AI engine in 2025, with a target of 20% by year-end, announced on the earnings call.
seo.resume_citable: In 2025, Delta Air Lines sets about 3% of its domestic fares with Fetcherr's AI engine and targets 20% by the end of 2025, according to its President on the earnings call.

faq.q: How does Delta use AI for its prices?
faq.a: Fetcherr's engine, a large market model, ingests searches, competitor prices, and demand signals, then sets the fare per route in place of fixed fare classes.

faq.q: What share of Delta's fares is set by AI?
faq.a: About 3% of the domestic network in the second quarter of 2025, versus 1% at the end of 2024, with an announced target of 20% for the end of 2025.

objectif_business: Set each fare at the level the market accepts, route by route, instead of relying on fixed fare classes, to capture more revenue per seat.
description: Delta is progressively replacing its fare-class grids with prices computed by Fetcherr's engine, described as a large market model. The system ingests consumer searches, competitor prices, and demand signals such as the weather, then sets the fare. In the second quarter of 2025, about 3 percent of domestic network fares were set by AI, up from 1 percent at the end of 2024, with an announced target of 20 percent by the end of 2025. Delta says it is still in a test and ramp-up phase.
points_cles: Fare-class grids replaced by AI-computed prices, route by route.
Fetcherr pricing engine (large market model) integrated into revenue management.
About 3% of domestic fares set by AI in Q2 2025, target 20% by end of 2025.
Evidence level A, status mixed signals.

niveau_preuve.justification: Figures and framing stated by Delta's President on the second-quarter 2025 earnings call, corroborated by several established press outlets that report the same values (3% current, 20% targeted).

stack_technique.detail: AI pricing engine (large market model) that ingests searches, competitor prices, and demand signals, then sets the price per route
in-house systems the engine is integrated into and that keep supervision of the AI-managed scope
surfaces where the computed fare is published and sold

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Continuous reoptimization of fares as demand and the market evolve.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Delta's revenue management team, with the Fetcherr pricing engine.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The demand predicted per route and date, cross-referenced with competitor prices and consumer searches. Without a reliable market data flow, the proposed price drifts and unit revenue degrades.

etapes.detail: Consumer searches, competitor prices, and demand signals such as the weather are aggregated continuously.
The large market model estimates demand and willingness to pay per route and date.
The engine sets a price per route, replacing the fixed fare classes.
The revenue management team progressively extends the scope of AI-managed fares and monitors the results.

prerequis_orga: integration of the pricing engine into the distribution channels
governance on price transparency and fairness
replication.premiere_etape: Isolate a subset of domestic routes and test the pricing engine there against the current fare grid.

playbook.action: Audit the data (booking and fare history, competitor prices, demand signals) and isolate a pilot scope of routes.
playbook.livrable: Pilot scope defined and data flows wired

playbook.action: Integrate the pricing engine into the revenue management and distribution systems.
Run the engine in shadow mode: compare its prices to the current grid without showing them.
playbook.livrable: Gap report and estimate of incremental revenue

playbook.action: Switch a small percentage of fares into production with safeguards (floors, ceilings, human supervision).
playbook.livrable: 1-3% of fares managed by AI with unit revenue monitoring

playbook.action: Ramp up progressively and set the governance on price transparency and fairness.
playbook.livrable: Extended scope with an oversight committee and reporting

replication.equipe: existing revenue management team + 1-2 data engineers for the integration + legal for price compliance

statut_vivant.note: The last quantified public confirmation dates to the July 2025 earnings call, with a target of 20% for the end of 2025. No verified quantified update in 2026, and the program prompted a request for explanations from US senators on AI-driven pricing.

transposable_ue.note: AI dynamic pricing is transposable, but the EU governs personalized pricing: the Omnibus directive requires informing the customer when a price is personalized by automated decision, GDPR requires a legal basis as soon as personal data feeds the price, and the AI Act requires documenting the use. Delta stresses demand-driven pricing, not individualized per person.
